# Sobaike Janao (সবাইকে জানাও)

> Independent, moderated citizen reporting and public-interest information platform for Bangladesh. This is not a government or law-enforcement website.

Canonical site: https://shobaikejanao.com/

## Main public pages

- Home: https://shobaikejanao.com/
- Reporting topics: https://shobaikejanao.com/issues
- Submit a report: https://shobaikejanao.com/report
- Explore reports and map: https://shobaikejanao.com/explore
- Search published reports: https://shobaikejanao.com/search
- Information and guidelines: https://shobaikejanao.com/more

## Main reporting categories

- Public safety: https://shobaikejanao.com/public-safety
- Harassment and abuse: https://shobaikejanao.com/harassment
- Extortion and bribery: https://shobaikejanao.com/extortion
- Road and transport: https://shobaikejanao.com/road-transport
- Utility issues: https://shobaikejanao.com/load-shedding
- Illegal occupation: https://shobaikejanao.com/illegal-occupation
- Illegal auto-rickshaw charging: https://shobaikejanao.com/rickshaw

## Crawling and indexing

- Sitemap: https://shobaikejanao.com/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://shobaikejanao.com/robots.txt
- Published report detail pages and valid category/location pages are indexable.
- Search-result and subject-aggregate pages may intentionally use noindex where appropriate.

## Safety and interpretation

Published reports are public-interest records and are not court judgments, official government determinations, or proof of criminal liability. For emergencies in Bangladesh, contact 999 or the relevant official hotline.
